data.title: JPMorgan Has Nearly $900 Million in Tokenized Funds on Ethereum and Solana. Which Chain Benefits More?
data.description: JPMorgan just parked nearly $900 million in tokenized funds across Ethereum and Solana, but the fine print reveals one chain got a much bigger piece of the deal than the headlines suggest.
